title: Avoid the Double Allocation
goal: Inspect slice elements without cloning or reallocating memory.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Ownership and Borrowing

hints: Look at whether any candidate clones items to read a u32 field.
u32 implements Copy, so reading item.price through &Item requires zero cloning.
explanation: Iterating over a slice with items.iter() yields shared references &Item. Reading item.price (a u32) copies the integer directly without cloning the item or its heap-allocated String. Using .cloned() or to_vec() clones every Item and allocates heap memory for no benefit. Always borrow slices when you only need to read field data.
